Hi Team,
I want to get ahead of a possible issue. The minimum piece weight for Item 20025 Sugar Free is 11.5 gr . The Theegarten cavity configuration has a maximum of 18 mm in height and 30 mm in length.

This means we would be running at 11.5 gr with an approximate height of 17.8 mm and a length of 30 mm.

This is similar to the Hershey product, where the minimum weight was adjusted from 11.5 gr to 11.3 gr. We will check the piece weight at the cut at the beginning, since the ingredients are different and the result could be different.

I wanted to bring this up ahead of time in case we need to evaluate the minimum weight or make adjustments to the Theegarten settings.
Thank you
Justin Garner Katya Farnsworth Candon Watt Charity Young Mary Montilla Chris Jeffs
